text: LV MCCs 00BFA30 and 00BFA50 to 00BFA80 are double-ended: two bus sections with a tie, fed from the A and B sections of their main switchboard; 00BFA40 is the main board of the CW intake, fed directly from 00BFT50/60. Duplicated consumers are connected to different sections, so that the loss of one section never removes both units of a redundant pair.
